boundary: This proves the packaged RemoteWorker leaf-certificate rotation path against the real Helm Control Plane and PostgreSQL on OrbStack, including local crash-replay material, atomic file replacement, new-identity reconnect, old-identity rejection and exact cleanup. The real run forced one rotation through the production path instead of waiting for the default five-minute-before-expiry wall-clock threshold; the threshold decision and pending-request restart behavior have focused unit tests. The customer node was a local fixed-digest Debian container with only the exec capability, not an external NAT host, and no Sandbox workload ran. This does not cover RemoteWorker CA trust-root rollover, Control Plane/Worker/Gateway service-certificate rotation, OIDC/JWKS or master-key rotation, external PostgreSQL/S3, HA, public ingress, real Provider credentials or published images. The candidate came from a dirty local tree and is not BASE-READY.
